| KGEG | 3/21 | 11,002 ft |
| KPDX | 10R/28L | 11,000 ft |
| KSEA | 16L/34R | 11,901 ft |

My extraction cut off after the first couple of runways on each page, so I didn't see every runway at KBOI, KPDX and KSEA. I'm assuming the unseen ones are shorter, since airnav lists the longest runway first on each page. That doesn't change the result, because KSEA's 11,901 ft is already the longest of the four.

ANSWER: KSEA, 11901
